newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to auction six-month maturity bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to auction six-month maturity bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Saturday it had invited bids up to Monday for the auction of six-month maturity short-term federal bonds.

It said the auction result would be announced on Tuesday with settlement set for Wednesday. A pre-auction target of 8.0 billion rupees had been set, but bids could be rejected without giving any reason.
In the last auction on February 4, bids worth 4.070 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 16.9403 percent per annum. ($1=40.22 rupees)
